purpose: Non-secret Coolify environment identity registry. Mirrors the aut_environments column shape from projects/automation/database/control-plane-schema.sql, which is a DRAFT, UNDEPLOYED schema — no live automation database exists, so this committed file is the repository's declaration of environment identity, following the projects/infrastructure/cloudflare/domain-inventory.json precedent.
contains_no_secrets: Environment and application UUIDs are opaque Coolify resource identifiers, matching aut_environments.environment_id ('stable opaque external id'). They are not credentials and grant no access on their own. No API token, password, or connection string appears in this file.
observation_method: Read-only SELECT of identity columns (project name, environment name, environment uuid, application uuid/name/status and per-environment resource counts) from the Coolify control-plane database. No write, no deployment API call, no credential value read or printed.

staging_source.notes: Branch derivation: the repository's committed deployment contract (ops/staging/coolify-provision.sh) defaults STAGING_GIT_BRANCH to main, but main does not contain /docker-compose.staging.yml (Coolify refused it fail-closed). release/darhijama-1.0.3 is the only committed ref carrying the staging contract and is production's exact source reference — no branch name was invented. Actual staging deployments pin immutable commit SHAs via the repository's Staging deployment workflow.

prohibited: This file declares identity only. It grants no permission, enables no connector, and authorises no deployment.

A production entry may never be used as a deployment target: the executor's assertStagingEnvironment refuses any record whose environment_key is not 'staging' or whose is_production is not exactly false.

Editing is_production or environment_key to make a production environment look like staging does not work — the executor additionally requires the platform's own reported environment to agree (two-source proof).
